verdict.rationale:
Missive's MCP integration explicitly supports permission-scoped access ('with the permissions you choose', docs-20) and a live probe of the hosted MCP server confirms a real OAuth flow advertising granular scopes (conversations:read/write, contacts:read, drafts:write, drafts:deliver, calendars:read/write) rather than an all-or-nothing key, directly matching the least-privilege agent-credential story. Custom MCP setup also lets admins choose an authentication method per connected server (docs-17).
missing for 10: no documentation/UI walkthrough showing an admin picking specific scopes before issuing a token, and no evidence the plain REST API (non-MCP) supports scoped/least-privilege keys.
